description: Preferred when you know the owner's email: type service_auth and login_hint. The reply's short fields come first: claim_attempt_token, user_code, claim_token, claim_page, then verification_uri. Use verification_uri only when its length matches verification_uri_length. If it was cut, build the link from claim_page and claim_attempt_token. Do not invent the host. Do not open claim_url alone. Do not register again when complete is missing and claim_token is present; call the claim endpoint once only if claim_attempt_token is missing. Scope omitted can create a shop. read_only cannot. type anonymous only when you do not yet have the email. identity_assertion is not accepted.
name: agents_register

claim_attempt_token.description: Short token. With claim_page it is the approval link. Never put user_code in that link.

claim_page.description: Page with no token. Not an approval link by itself.

user_code.description: 6 digit code. Show it to the person; they type it on the claim page. Never put it in a URL.

verification_uri.description: Full approval link. Use it only when its length equals verification_uri_length.

claim_token.description: Secret. Keep it; you poll the token endpoint with it.
